samples.question: Which halo color belongs to the candidate object matching the REFERENCE mosaic? Each mosaic is five uniquely colored square tiles in one connected asymmetric shape. A whole candidate mosaic may be rotated by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees; reflection is not allowed. Match the tile colors and their relative arrangement, then report the matched candidate's halo color. A is the left candidate and B is the right candidate. Ignore panel position, tile size, and halo size. Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
